derived_rules.reason: A mole is ordinarily subterranean and only rarely comes to the surface; flooding often destroys burrows. Cathemeral activity therefore does not establish a visible surface animal.
Night foraging is conditional on damp or rainy habitat.
Heat cue is placed in daylight.
Sunny summer is placed in daylight.
WK dusk-to-dawn activity and owner dusk/night sound are combined editorially for dawn sound.
Approximate 04:00 call is mapped through the median month of each season and that month's civil dawn/sunrise in local mean solar time.
Summer civil-dusk sheep visibility is an editorial analogy from the documented cattle evening return, combined with sheep summer care; no direct sheep dusk source is claimed.
